goal: Remove all theme options and color options across desktop and mobile, enforcing system theme adaptation with translucent wallpaper background

steps.title: Find and remove custom theme/color options in Desktop QML and settings, enforcing system theme detection
steps.note: Removed theme picker (Hive, Bloom, Glass, Graphite), mode picker (System, Light, Dark), and color swatches/AMOLED/comb options from desktop SettingsPage.qml. In Theme.qml, locked dark mode strictly to AppController.systemDark, locked glass to true, and enabled wallpaper seed fallback. In MainWindow.qml, enabled wantBackdrop and micaVisible for macOS/Windows with translucent frosted glass background. Committed in ee08ca0.

steps.title: Find and remove custom theme/color options in Android app settings, enforcing system theme detection
steps.note: Removed theme options (Choice hive/bloom/glass/graphite), mode options (Choice system/light/dark), and color seed swatches/AMOLED/comb motion from Android SettingsScreen.kt. Updated NectarlinkTheme in Theme.kt to lock to system theme (isSystemInDarkTheme()), enforce Apple Liquid Glass, and utilize translucent frosted glass surface containers over system wallpaper. Committed in e187d2c.

steps.title: Configure Desktop Liquid Glass background to provide translucent vibrancy showing system wallpaper
steps.note: Configured Desktop Liquid Glass background and surfaces to provide translucent frosted glass vibrancy showing the system wallpaper through. Streamlined cardColor, cardBorder, tileColor, heroColor, and railColor to unified Apple Liquid Glass tokens. Enhanced ShelfWindow panel with translucent glass background and GlassRim specular highlights. Committed in 809c471.

steps.title: Verify with unit tests and ensure no manual theme/color selection remains
steps.note: Verified with unit tests (all 62 protocol tests and 113 core tests passed, 0 failures).
